resumeText:
Sameer Khan | Bengaluru | sameer.khan@example.com

SUMMARY
Engineering leader with 17 years building consumer and fintech platforms.

EXPERIENCE
VP of Engineering, Sahyadri Lending, Bengaluru (2020 - present)
- Set the technology strategy and three-year platform roadmap with the CEO.
- Own high level design reviews for the lending, payments and data platforms.
- Took architecture decisions on moving the monolith to services.
- Grew the engineering team to 120 through engineering hiring and interview loops.
- Managed a team of 9 engineering managers.
- Run budget forecasting for cloud and vendor spend each quarter.
- Give monthly board updates on delivery, reliability and technology risk.
- Drive cross-functional collaboration with product, risk and operations.

Engineering Manager, Konark Retail Tech, Pune (2014 - 2020)
- Led checkout and catalogue teams.

Software Engineer to Tech Lead, various product companies (2009 - 2014)

EDUCATION
BTech Computer Science, IIT Bombay, 2009
